messages:
incident-bot: Pager: latency-anomaly detected in /v1/generate (p95 & p99 spike). Alert ID: LTY-20260314-03. Auto-escalation to #incidents; paging oncall-sre.

oncall-sre: Got it — taking lead. Observed p95 ~820ms, p99 ~2.3s across US-west at 02:07 UTC. Streaming stalls reported on web clients. Marking SEV-2 for now.

alex_k: seeing a big bump in auth latencies (auth-db RPCs). Tracing shows auth service latencies spiking and code paths waiting on `config-fetch` for feature flags before starting model execution.

maria_p: Confirming. Prom query: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(auth_request_duration_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le))` -> ~760ms. Also `redwood_inference_streaming_stalls_total` up x8 in 5m.

jordan_eng: Logs from runtime node 9: `WARN control-plane: feature-flag fetch 504 after 12000ms` repeated. Streaming path blocked on `get_flags(user_id)`.

oncall-sre: Possible root cause candidates: 1) control-plane config-service rate limiting 2) auth DB connection pool exhaustion 3) rate-limiter/backpressure on control-plane. Start triage checklist: metrics, traces, logs, recent deploys, and mitigation plan.

samir_prod: No deploys in last hour. We pushed an infra config two hours ago (cache TTL lowered to 5s for flags) — could be stomping the config service.

eli_cs: Customers reporting slow responses and some SDK streaming timeouts. I have a list of affected accounts (3 enterprise tenants flagged). Prioritize communication after mitigation.

alex_k: Running quick checks: `pg_stat_activity` on auth-db shows many idle-in-transaction? Actually many active waiting on `SELECT flags FROM configs WHERE tenant_id=...` with sequential scans. Query timeouts around 10-12s.

maria_p: Redis cache hit rate for flags dropped from 98% -> 32% in the last 6m. TTL change might have bumped traffic to DB.

oncall-sre: Immediate mitigations (short term):
- Increase config-service rate limit to allow more concurrency (fail open on flags)
- Re-enable longer TTL for feature-flag cache to reduce DB pressure
- Bypass flag fetch for streaming path (hotfix): use cached default flags if fetch exceeds 300ms
- Add temporary read-replica for auth-db if feasible

jordan_eng: I can push a hotfix to runtime that does: if `flags_fetch` > 300ms -> fallback to `cached_defaults` and emit `flag_fallback` metric. Pushing PR now.

samir_prod: I'm going to increase config-service concurrency pool and rehydrate Redis from snapshot; also bump rate limit quota for internal control-plane calls.

oncall-sre: Action owners: jordan -> runtime hotfix (PR #1422), samir -> config-service concurrency + redis rehydrate, alex -> monitor DB and open read-replica if necessary, maria -> watch SLO dashboards & customer impact. I'll coordinate comms and update timeline.

jordan_eng: PR merged, rolling restart runtime nodes in canary group (10%). Command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime --namespace=prod --selector=canary=true`.

alex_k: Spun up a read-replica and pointed config reads to replica for non-critical queries. Connection pool temporarily increased from 50 -> 120 for the config user.

maria_p: After config-service concurrency bump and redis rehydrate, cache hit rate back to ~85% in 3m. p95 down to ~380ms, p99 ~900ms. Streaming stalls decreased but still some tail.

oncall-sre: Good progress. Next we need to confirm the auth path isn't re-introducing stalls due to other control-plane calls. Check rate-limiter metrics: `control_plane_ratelimit_rejections_total` increased sharply before the spike.

alex_k: Yup, rate-limiters were rejecting many internal calls. I increased quota by 2x for internal control-plane clients. Rejections now near zero. Follow-up: reviewing slow queries - added index on `configs(tenant_id, updated_at)` to avoid seq scans.

samir_prod: Noted: we reverted TTL change and added more conservative rate-limiter rules. Also disabled aggressive feature-flag invalidation job that ran every 5s.

oncall-sre: Customer impact assessment: 3 enterprise tenants saw >2x p95 for 12-28 minutes. ~120k requests affected system-wide during window. No data loss, but measurable QoE degradation on streaming (clients reported stalls and reconnects).

eli_cs: I've drafted an incident note to send to affected customers with ETA for RCA in 6 hours. Waiting for final confirmation on mitigation completeness.

maria_p: Dashboards show p95 steadying ~250-320ms now, p99 fluctuating 600-1kms depending on region. We should keep alert thresholds at current until next oncall checks.

jordan_eng: Runtime hotfix is fully rolled out. Added telemetry to count `flag_fallback` occurrences — small % (~3%) currently.
